# Source: spaceops/templates/postgres.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: spaceops-postgres
  namespace: spaceops-stage
  labels:
    helm.sh/chart: spaceops-0.1.0
    app.kubernetes.io/name: spaceops
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: spaceops
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "0.1.0"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    app.kubernetes.io/component: postgres
spec:
  serviceName: spaceops-postgres
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: spaceops
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: spaceops
      app.kubernetes.io/component: postgres
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: spaceops
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: spaceops
        app.kubernetes.io/component: postgres
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: spaceops-postgres
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: pgvector/pgvector:pg15
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: postgres
              containerPort: 5432
          env:
            # GCE PD (and some CSI volumes) place lost+found at the mount root; initdb requires a subdir.
            - name: PGDATA
              value: "/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata"
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              value: "spaceops"
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              value: "spaceops"
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: spaceops-stage-secrets
                  key: postgres-password
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - pg_isready
                - -U
                - spaceops
                - -d
                - spaceops
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - pg_isready
                - -U
                - spaceops
                - -d
                - spaceops
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 1Gi
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data
      spec:
        accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 10Gi
